risks.risk: The engine may not be a genuine Toyota or may be a used part from a different brand.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the engine identification plate (usually on the side or bottom).

risks.risk: The engine may be seized, have internal damage, or have a blown head gasket.
risks.proof: A video of the engine running or a compression test result.

risks.risk: The timing belt may be old or the pulleys may be damaged.
risks.proof: A photo of the engine with a timestamp showing the date of the photo.
risks.if_unproven: as requiring a new timing belt

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Photo of the engine identification plate showing the brand and model.
Photo of the engine with a timestamp showing the date of the photo.
Video of the engine running or a compression test result.
response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
